summary: Set up alerts so you reach out at exactly the right moment.

useCases.title: Get notified when a target account is ready to buy
useCases.message: Help me set up trigger-based monitoring on my target accounts. Ask me where my target account list lives. If you don't already know what signals I care about, ask: funding rounds, new hires, leadership changes, or something else. Then set up a Routine that checks for those signals each week and alerts me when one of my targets hits a trigger.
